about: The measured width of every legend the registry can draw (each enum and boolean option
label, each "n · label" of a dial of 7 or more options, the numerals 1 to 12), at 12 px
in the panel legend's computed font (--osc-font, system-ui first), weights 400 and 600,
in each engine of Playwright 1.63 on each platform. A width is the greatest of the SVG
advance (getComputedTextLength in the panel's own svg), the canvas advance and the
canvas ink (actualBoundingBoxLeft + Right, at 12 px and at 120 px / 10), rounded up to
0.01; getBBox and getBoundingClientRect are not used, since Firefox pads an SVG text's
box. Measured 2026-11-05 for LEG-1; tests/unit/ui-synth-legend.test.mjs holds
